raw.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a talented and strategic Principal, Art Direction to join a fast-paced, high-performing team supporting one of our most visible, dynamic clients. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table.

As a key leader within the creative department, you will not only translate strategy into smart, engaging creative but also mentor a multidisciplinary team of designers and creators. You’ll partner closely with Copywriters, Video Editors, and Content Creators, reporting to the Creative Director to ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream, managing junior talent, and consistently raising the creative bar.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

.WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Deliver High-Impact Creative: Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social, and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.
  • Mentor & Lead: Act as a direct supervisor and mentor to junior and mid-level Art Directors and Designers. Provide clear, constructive feedback to creatives across disciplines (for example, to copy) to elevate the team's output and foster professional growth.
  • Support Video + Content Production: Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.
  • Partner Across Disciplines: Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.
  • Manage Creative Execution: Own the work from end to end. Concepting and producing polished on-brand, performance-minded assets that meet timelines and briefs. As an Associate Director, Art Direction, you will lead by doing, driving execution while strategically delegating portions of our projects to our junior team members to support efficiency, mentorship and delivery while remaining accountable for the final output.
  • Be a Problem Solver: Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.
  • Cultivate Culture: Foster an inclusive, high-energy environment. Lead daily brainstorms and inspiration-sharing sessions to keep the team’s creative pulse sharp.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • 5+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.
  • Prior social agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.
  • On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.
  • Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.
  • Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.
  • A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.
  • A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401K plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

This is a remote position.

About Us

Ellit Groups is a Private Equity-backed, woman, minority-led healthcare IT consulting firm focused on Provider and Payer organizations. We partner with healthcare leaders who value operational excellence, real-world experience, and diverse perspectives to drive better outcomes.

Our firm is built by former healthcare operators who understand the realities of running complex healthcare systems. This combination of operator credibility and investment-backed growth enables us to deliver high-impact, scalable solutions.

We differentiate ourselves by bringing practical experience, executive-level insight, and a relentless focus on quality and outcomes. Our success is directly tied to our clients’ success.

Position Overview
Our Client is seeking an experienced Epic Certified Cadence Analyst to support the design, build, configuration, and optimization of Epic Cadence scheduling functionality. This role will partner closely with operational, clinical, and technical stakeholders to ensure efficient scheduling workflows, improved patient access, and optimized appointment management across the organization.
Location & Work Environment
This role is primarily remote, with approximately one onsite visit per quarter as needed to support project or operational requirements. Candidates interested in relocating may be eligible for a relocation package. This position is currently structured as hourly with eligibility for overtime; however, it is expected to transition to a full-time salaried role in the future.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and maintain Epic Cadence scheduling functionality
  • Support appointment templates, provider schedules, referral workflows, and access center operations
  • Collaborate with operational leaders and clinical teams to gather requirements and translate them into system solutions
  • Troubleshoot scheduling issues and support break/fix resolution in Cadence workflows
  • Participate in Epic upgrades, enhancements, and optimization initiatives
  • Support reporting and analytics related to scheduling access and utilization
  • Ensure adherence to organizational standards, documentation, and change control processes
  • Assist in training and supporting end users on scheduling workflows and best practices

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • 5–10 years of experience as an Epic Analyst with Cadence certification required
  • Strong background in Epic scheduling build, configuration, and workflow optimization
  • Experience supporting large healthcare organizations or multi-site scheduling environments
  • Proven ability to work with operational stakeholders to improve access and scheduling efficiency

Preferred Skills

  • Strong understanding of ambulatory scheduling workflows and access management principles
  • Experience with Epic Prelude or Grand Central is a plus
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience working in Agile or structured project environments preferred

Benefits

Benefits

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment.
  • Professional development opportunities to advance your career.
  • Flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance.

LIMS Consultant (Post-Sales Implementation)

Remote within USA

Overview

As a LIMS Consultant on our Professional Services team, you’ll play a key role in supporting customers post-sale, with a focus on implementing our next-generation LIMS platform, Labbit. Drawing on your expertise in laboratory science and informatics, you’ll serve as a dedicated consultant, working directly with customers to understand their needs, configure solutions, and ensure the successful implementation and adoption of our product.

This role spans consultation, requirements gathering, documentation, LIMS configuration, validation testing, support ticket resolution, and light project management. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with our implementation and customer success teams to deliver high-quality solutions tailored to each customer’s unique workflows. In some cases, you may also support customer projects outside of Labbit. To succeed in this role, you should thrive on becoming a reliable partner to our customers while managing smooth, high-quality implementations.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team that’s passionate about helping labs accelerate innovation through thoughtful software implementation and expert support. We’re excited to connect with candidates seeking a highly collaborative role at the intersection of science and technology.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary scientific and technical contact for customers during implementation projects
  • Utilize technical and domain expertise to understand client needs and translate them into solution designs, software requirements, and implementation plans
  • Create scope estimates and/or feature development requests for Implementation teams
  • Configure LIMS to meet user requirements
  • Create test plans and execute testing to ensure that the configured system meets client needs
  • Lead project coordination, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and expectations are clearly communicated and met
  • Develop customer-facing documentation and provide training to support the adoption
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing customer insights and informing product development.
  • Share customer insights to inform continuous improvement and product development

Must Haves

  • Strong background in Life Sciences (e.g., Chemistry, Molecular Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, or related field), with hands-on lab or LIMS experience.
  • Familiarity with configuring scientific software or laboratory workflows, including scripting (e.g., Python), JSON, and SQL for data handling.
  • Knowledge of analytical workflows, particularly in Quality testing.
  • Proven ability to work directly with customers, translating technical and domain-specific needs into practical software solutions.
  • Excellent organizational skills with experience coordinating tasks and timelines across teams.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can educate, support, and build trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Fast learner with a solutions-oriented mindset and strong attention to detail.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience implementing LIMS, LES, ELNs, or related lab informatics platforms.
  • Previous experience in a professional services, consulting, or project-based customer role.
  • Familiarity with software development processes and Agile teams.

This role is open to candidates based in Canada, with hybrid work available for those near our Victoria, BC headquarters. At Semaphore, we’re building a purpose-driven team of professionals who continually grow their expertise and make a real impact in life sciences. Our people are at the heart of our culture and our customers' success, and we’re committed to supporting them with autonomy, flexibility, and genuine care.

To further support our team, we offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive vacation
  • Health Insurance
  • 401K matching
  • Annual professional development budget
  • The expected salary range for this role is $110,000 - $145,000 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, domain expertise, and geographic location.

About BFG

Business Financial Group (BFG) is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, and advisory firm serving small and medium-sized businesses across the United States. We provide accounting, payroll, tax preparation, tax planning, tax resolution, and CFO advisory services.

Our mission is to become the most trusted financial partner for small business owners by combining U.S. CPA leadership with highly skilled accounting and tax professionals based in India.

We are seeking a highly practical and experienced U.S. Tax & Accounting Manager who has worked with multiple U.S. CPA firms or through an offshore accounting/tax outsourcing organization serving numerous U.S. CPA firm clients.

This is a hands-on management role, not a purely compliance-focused tax position.

Working Hours:

Monday through Friday, 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM (IST) (One hour break from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST).

Home Office Requirements

To ensure productivity and uninterrupted work, candidates must have:

  • A dedicated, quiet, and distraction-free workspace

  • A laptop with dual monitors

  • High-speed internet with minimum speeds of:

    • 150 Mbps download

    • 9 Mbps upload

    • (Test your speed atwww.speedtest.net)

  • Backup internet solution (e.g., mobile hotspot or alternate broadband)

  • Reliable power supply with a backup source (e.g., inverter or UPS)

  • Noise-cancelling headset for virtual meetings.

Position Summary

The U.S. Tax & Accounting Manager will oversee client accounting and tax engagements, mentor junior team members, review work quality, assist with tax planning and tax resolution projects, and serve as a technical resource for the accounting and tax team.

The ideal candidate has experience working with multiple U.S. businesses across various industries and understands how accounting, payroll, sales tax, tax planning, and tax preparation work together.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Review

  • Review monthly and year-end bookkeeping engagements

  • Review reconciliations including bank, credit card, loan, payroll, and balance sheet accounts

  • Review financial statements and identify inconsistencies or unusual transactions

  • Assist with cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects

  • Guide staff in maintaining accurate General Ledger records

  • Review adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting adjustments

Tax Preparation & Review

  • Prepare and review:

    • Form 1040

    • Form 1040NR

    • Form 1065

    • Form 1120

    • Form 1120S

    • State tax returns

  • Review workpapers and supporting schedules

  • Identify tax risks, omissions, and planning opportunities

  • Assist with complex business and individual tax engagements

Tax Planning

  • Identify proactive tax-saving opportunities for business owners

  • Assist with entity selection and restructuring discussions

  • Support quarterly tax planning engagements

  • Analyze compensation structures, shareholder distributions, and estimated tax strategies

  • Assist clients with year-end tax minimization planning

Tax Resolution

  • Review IRS notices and correspondence

  • Assist with transcript analysis

  • Support installment agreements and compliance projects

  • Help gather documentation for tax resolution cases

  • Coordinate with senior tax professionals on complex IRS matters

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Review work prepared by junior accountants and tax preparers

  • Provide constructive feedback and coaching

  • Assist in developing training materials and SOPs

  • Support technical growth of team members

  • Help develop future reviewers and senior staff

Project Management

  • Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously

  • Monitor project deadlines and workflow progress

  • Coordinate work among accounting and tax team members

  • Escalate issues proactively

  • Ensure timely and accurate client deliverables


Requirements

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related field

Professional Credentials (Preferred)

  • EA (Enrolled Agent)

  • CPA Candidate

  • CA Inter / CA

  • U.S. Tax Certifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of U.S. tax and accounting experience

  • Experience working with an India-based outsourcing firm supporting multiple U.S. CPA firms OR direct experience with multiple U.S. CPA firms

  • Experience handling multiple client engagements simultaneously

  • Experience reviewing staff work

raw.description:
Build reliable platforms that help healthcare teams deliver better care.

Zynx Health is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, secure, automate, and continuously improve the technology platforms behind evidence-based clinical decision support solutions. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex platform problems, improving developer experience, and strengthening the reliability of systems that support healthcare organizations and clinical teams.

You will join a collaborative Technology organization where DevOps, product development, architecture, security, QA, and data platform teams work together to make applications and services buildable, deployable, observable, secure, scalable, recoverable, and maintainable across the full delivery lifecycle.

This position is remote within the United States.

Zynx Health is currently seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer in the Technology department. The Senior DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in advancing DevOps execution, platform engineering, CI/CD automation, operational reliability, secure delivery practices, and cloud/container enablement across Zynx Health technology platforms.

In this role, you will own and improve assigned platforms and services, support high-availability healthcare technology environments, and help ensure the secure handling, storage, transmission, and processing of customer/client data, PHI, and PII. You will also help establish reusable automation patterns, operational standards, and documentation that make our systems easier to operate and safer to change.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and maintain deployment pipelines, platform tooling, automation scripts, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and operational runbooks that improve consistency and reduce manual work.
  • Operate, harden, and continuously improve OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, and container-based environments across development, test, staging, and production workflows.
  • Support AWS infrastructure and managed services, including IAM, VPC, EC2, RDS, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, load balancing, security groups, and KMS.
  • Build and improve CI/CD and GitOps delivery workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Tekton, OpenShift GitOps, ArgoCD, and comparable automation frameworks.
  • Automate build, test, dependency analysis, image scanning, package, deployment, rollback, verification, and release governance processes.
  • Strengthen observability, reliability, and resilience through logging, monitoring, tracing, dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, telemetry, incident analysis, backup/restore validation, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices into pipelines, environments, access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, certificate handling, and operational workflows.
  • Partner with Security & Compliance to support HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, OWASP, NIST, auditability, policy enforcement, software supply chain security, and risk mitigation expectations.
  • Support application and data platform operations involving Java/Groovy Spring Boot, .NET Core/C#, Svelte/SvelteKit, React, TypeScript, MarkLogic, PostgreSQL, Redis, Apache Kafka, Amazon RDS, and related technologies.
  • Lead structured troubleshooting across application, infrastructure, CI/CD, container, runtime, identity, network, DNS, TLS, database, messaging, and data-service layers.
  • Mentor DevOps engineers, software developers, and project contributors on operational readiness, automation patterns, troubleshooting practices, secure delivery, and platform standards.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate scripting, pipeline development, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational analysis while validating all outputs before use in shared or production environments.

What You Bring

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern DevOps, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, secure delivery, cloud infrastructure, and operational reliability practices.
  • Deep working knowledge of OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS infrastructure, cloud-native operating models, and container-based environments.
  • Ability to design, implement, troubleshoot, and improve deployment pipelines, platform automation, safe rollout and rollback patterns, and operational controls.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, scripting, repeatable environment provisioning, lifecycle management, and safe change-management practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across application, infrastructure, container, runtime, identity, network, DNS, TLS, database, messaging, and data-service layers.
  • Working knowledge of observability and reliability practices, including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, incident response, SLI/SLO practices, backup/restore validation, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Security-first mindset with practical experience in secure configuration, secrets management, access control, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Ability to communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, implementation options, operational impacts, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative approach to working with development, QA, architecture, security, compliance, data engineering, infrastructure, and operational teams.
  • Strong documentation habits, including runbooks, operational notes, platform standards, diagrams, support expectations, and implementation guidance.

Required Experience

  • Typically 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, systems engineering, cloud infrastructure, or comparable technology roles.
  • Demonstrated experience operating as a senior hands-on engineer with ownership of complex platform, automation, reliability, security, or operational initiatives in production environments.
  • Strong experience with OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS infrastructure, cloud-native operating models, and container-based environments.
  • Strong experience with GitLab CI/CD, Tekton, OpenShift GitOps, ArgoCD, or comparable CI/CD, GitOps, and release automation tooling.
  • Strong experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, incident response, backup/restore validation, disaster recovery planning, and system reliability practices.
  • Strong experience with secure configuration, secrets management, access control, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting PostgreSQL administration or operations in Amazon RDS and self-managed environments.
  • Working knowledge of Java/Groovy Spring Boot services, .NET Core/C# services, or modern frontend delivery patterns.
  • Familiarity with MarkLogic, Redis, Apache Kafka, Keycloak, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Wiz, Tenable, Snyk, SonarQube, and related tooling.
  • Experience working in healthcare, regulated, compliance-sensitive, high-availability, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, OWASP, or NIST-aligned environments.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools in engineering workflows with appropriate validation, code review, privacy, and security practices.

Why Join Zynx Health?

  • Meaningful mission: help build smart healthcare technology that supports evidence-based practices and better patient care.
  • Modern platform work: contribute to cloud, container, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, reliability, security, and automation initiatives that directly improve engineering effectiveness.
  • Senior technical ownership: solve complex problems, lead technical workstreams, mentor others, and influence how platforms are built and operated.
  • Collaborative environment: work across DevOps, product development, architecture, QA, data engineering, and Security & Compliance teams.
  • Remote work model: contribute from anywhere in the United States as part of a fully remote organization.

About Zynx Health

Zynx Health, a part of Hearst Health, is the market leader in providing evidence-based clinical decision support solutions that help healthcare organizations measurably improve patient outcomes, enhance safety, and lower costs. Thousands of hospital organizations and providers “dare to be better” with Zynx Health's rigorously developed and maintained evidence-based clinical content, patented technology, and tailored services to drive clinical improvements at the point of care. With Zynx Health, healthcare organizations exceed industry demands for delivering high-quality care at lower costs under value-based reimbursement models. Zynx Health partners with healthcare organizations to continuously and measurably improve care every day, for every patient, every time.

Zynx Health seeks to hire and train employees who uphold and mirror our core values of Bold Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Respect and Excellence. To learn more, visit www.zynxhealth.com or call 855.367.ZYNX. Zynx Health offers competitive salary and extensive benefits - including medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, life insurance, and matching 401k.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected military and veteran status.

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Los Angeles, CA. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Los Angeles, is $112,000 - $135,000. Please note this information is specific to those hired in location. If this role is open to candidates outside of location, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending savings account; paid holidays; paid time off; employee assistance program; and other company beneﬁts.

Help us build the operating system for human longevity.

Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We’re a small team and offer real ownership from day one.

We need someone who owns their work completely: sets the direction, writes the copy, reads the data, and adjusts without waiting to be asked.

Product messaging

  • Lead value proposition development across our portfolio: smart ring, app, red light therapy devices, and future products
  • Own B2C messaging across segments: app users, ring buyers, health-conscious early adopters
  • Test and iterate messaging based on engagement data, in close partnership with the product team

Website and e-commerce

  • Own our website and updates across launches, campaigns, and seasonal priorities
  • Manage and optimise our Shopify store: product launches, descriptions, landing pages, conversion elements
  • Support fulfilment and logistics setup ahead of our US market launch
  • Spot and fix proactively what isn't working

App marketing

  • Own App Store and Play Store positioning: listings, keywords, visuals, download and activation performance
  • Drive ranking and conversion improvements through systematic testing
  • Support app launches and in-app messaging

Content marketing

  • Define and own content strategy across YouTube, email, and in-app touchpoints
  • Run our YouTube channel (80K subscribers): scripting, briefing, publishing, optimisation, audience engagement
  • Develop written content — newsletters, blog posts, web copy — that builds positioning and drives acquisition
  • Own the content calendar; at a later stage, reactivate additional social channels
  • Plan, write, and execute lifecycle and campaign emails via Brevo. Own subscriber growth and funnel touchpoint quality.
  • Test & iterate and report on performance across activities with your own conclusions.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of hands-on digital marketing in a B2C product or B2B SaaS context, with ownership of outcomes
  • Proven ability to develop product messaging strategy, not just execute it
  • Strong copywriting in English across formats: email, long-form, short-form, UX copy, video scripts
  • Experience with GenAI tools and AI-assisted/automated marketing flows
  • Data-driven: you track results, form conclusions, and adjust without being prompted
  • Takes ownership: makes well-reasoned calls independently rather than waiting for direction. Moves toward problems, not around them.
  • Based in EU timezone, working as an independent contractor

The following are strong advantages:

  • YouTube experience: strategy, scripting, or channel management at scale
  • App marketing experience
  • Fluency in wellness, fitness, and longevity topics
  • B2B marketing exposure in premium or professional services
  • Previous experience in Performance Marketing
  • Fluency in German

Send your resume with examples of work you've led: email campaigns, app marketing campaigns, YouTube content, or messaging strategy.

Even crazier, Forbes says this number is low due to the impact of COVID. Which has forced online learning to go from a nicety to a necessity, becoming the center of our lives as we adapt to a rapidly changing employment landscape.

Imagine having 3-6, high-quality, high-interest prospects plopped onto your calendar every single day. People who have already been warmed up by cutting-edge marketing and are eager to hear exactly what you’re offering.

That’s the reality for members of our sales team.

And as if that isn’t sweet enough, you’ll enjoy 15% - 20% commissions on products ranging from $3,000 to $20,000.

There is lots of opportunity for growth within the company...and our commission plans are uncapped.

But we’re picky with who we let on the team.

Because keeping our culture intact as we continue to grow is extremely important to us.

Our founder has been doing the sales himself and ready to bring on a sales partner.

This is a team of people who want to make a lot of money, have fun while they do it and constantly improve their sales game.

If that sounds like you - please apply.

This is a commission-based opportunity that operates through gross sales, not profit.

That means for a true sales closer there is an unlimited earning potential.

Minimum 6 months experience as a sales closer over the phone/on video with a B2C offer (not B2B) with $25,000 in gross revenue.

Collaborative, team player.

Track record of 20%+ close rate while maintaining high integrity in sales.

Ability to maintain strong internal communication (notes in CRM, communicate with sales manager, record calls for review, etc.).

Experience with outbound lead generation (we’ve found paid, inbound leads are cake for people who have actually had to hunt for their sales).

Ability to maintain positive mindset and energy at all times.

A master of authoritative empathy with prospects.

Smart follow up strategy (not “just checking in”).

Ability to persuasively paint before and after scenarios for prospects.

Overcome objections to generate sales.

Coach people through their fear to becoming the successful person they want to be on the other side.

Knack for customizing sales conversations to each prospect.

Simplifying complicated ideas in a way that is persuasive and doesn’t overwhelm.

Experience successfully selling online education to consumers.

Understanding of digital marketing concepts and strategies.

Experience having taken an online course or tried making money before.

Selling on the phone and via video chat on Zoom

Diligent follow up via email and/or text

Proactively suggests ideas to improve sales process and pitch

Record the customer’s personal information, detailed and accurately, with our CRM software

Keep records of calls and sales and record useful information with CRM software

Collaborate with team to improve sales overall

Requirements:

  • Smart phone and laptop with internet access and social media

* Have a strong drive for success

  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly - this is a fast paced environment

* Solution focused vs. excuse focused

About Us:

Legion of Loan Officers is a fast-growing education company, built by a team that is passionate about fixing education and bridging the world’s skills gap.

Our courses focus on a unique blend of technical skills, soft skills (like sales), mindset, accountability, group coaching and 1-on-1 mentorship from top industry experts.

In other words, we show Loan Officers and Mortgage Brokers how to actually make money - not just skills and theory.

The result is a potent online education that helps graduates see upwards of 100x return on investment in short periods of time.

Our founder – Nick Carpenter - has been in the Marketing & Business Growth coaching space for almost 10 years.

He has extensive experience in media buying, marketing strategies, sales strategies, and powerful problem solving that has helped hundreds (yes hundreds) of Mortgage Brokers and Loan Officers grow and scale their businesses.

Nick has coached many students who have gone from low 6 figures to 8 figures business in as little as one year.

Every course or coaching program that you sell with LOLO has incredible content, delivery and support.

That means every offer is one a salesperson can feel confident it will truly change people’s lives when they sell it.

What you get working with us:

  • Work from home (or anywhere you can focus)
  • Flexible schedule - work whenever you want as long as it’s 20 hours+ a week

* International travel opportunities

*Ongoing sales training

  • A work/life balanced culture (as long as you’re closing sales - we don’t care)
  • Access to a wide variety of paid tools that help you close more sales with automations
  • High quality, high interest paid leads on your calendar asking to be sold
  • A team who’s open to ideas on how to generate more leads with our powerful marketing team
  • Lucrative sales bonus structure and competition

How to Apply:

To apply, please fill out written answers and film video answers to our questions - you’ll be selling on video so how you present yourself there is key.

If you have a recorded sales call, please send it as that will help significantly.

Zoom interview

Schedule:

Monday to Friday, Saturdays and Sundays are optional

Commission Pay

Bonuses available

We work remotely so you have full control of where you work.

Fully Remote

Innovative -- innovative and risk-taking

Outcome-oriented -- results-focused with strong performance culture

Team-oriented -- cooperative and collaborative

A job for which military experienced candidates are encouraged to apply

A job for which all ages, including older job seekers, are encouraged to apply

Open to applicants who do not have a college diploma

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

NOCD is looking for a Licensed Therapist (LP, LMHC, LMFT, LICSW) based in Massachusetts to join our team.

As a provider with NOCD, we want you to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions
  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Evening Availability Consists of:
      • Monday - Friday: 3:00 - 8:00 PM local time
      • Saturday & Sunday: 8 hours of availability per day
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Massachusetts: (Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker)
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT) preferred
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Massachusetts = $70,000 - $105,000
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401(k) match, and paid parental leave for eligible employees
  • PTO based on an accrual system
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Specialized ERP training with experienced OCD providers
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Centralized scheduling
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases

raw.excerpt: About NOCD NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).
raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About The Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, NOCD, wants our Therapists to focus on what's most important – treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPC, LMFT, LCSW) in New Jersey to join our network.
We will provide the training necessary to become a specialized therapist and ensure you are fully equipped to deliver effective, evidence-based treatment.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • New Jersey: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT) preferred
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in New Jersey = $65,000 - $88,000
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, 401(k) match, and paid parental leave for eligible employees
  • PTO based on an accrual system
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Specialized ERP training with experienced OCD providers
  • Work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases

TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d’un(e) conseiller en architecture d’intégration en intelligence d’affaires ayant d’excellentes aptitudes techniques, d’excellentes connaissances et qui souhaite mettre à profit ses compétences au sein d’une équipe polyvalente.

Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue.

Description des travaux ou des biens livrables :

- Assurer la cohérence avec la vision de l’architecture d’entreprise;
- Collaborer avec les utilisateurs des secteurs d’affaires afin d’assurer la cohérence des besoins d’affaires;
- Collaborer avec l’architecte organique ETC et l’architecte de données àla mise en œuvre de la solution globale du projet;
- Accord de niveau de service (SLA);

- Contribue à l’équipe d’architecture entreprise afin établir la feuille de route (Roadmap) du programme/projet IA en adéquation au carnet decommande priorisé par le processus de gouvernance;
- Accompagne la direction dans la gouvernance et la gestion duprogramme et des projets IA;
- Participe à l’étape d’identification des besoins d’affaires pour les projetsafin de s’assurer que l’architecture cible les adressera adéquatement;
- Convient des composantes d’une solution, en lien avec les besoinsexprimés, avec les architectes Données/ETL/Interface client;
- Oriente l’architecture des solutions;
- Assure l’arrimage entre la gouvernance, l'architecture d'entreprise, l’architecture d’affaires IA et les architectures de solutions de données,de l’interface client et des ETL;
- Supporte l’équipe pour les orientations IA et les bonnes pratiques;
- Anime et alimente la table d'architecture IA;
- Effectue régulièrement une veille des meilleures pratiques et del’innovation en matière d’IA et de gestion des données;
- S’assure que la documentation d’architecture est réalisée et tenue à jour(avec les outils conformes de la Société);
- Participe à la table d’architecture TI.

- Dossier d’opportunité;
- Dossier d’affaire;
- Architecture de vision;
- Carnet de commandes;
- Fiche indicateur;
- SLA;
- SLO;
- Gouvernance

Profil

1)Posséder quinze (15) années d’expérience professionnelle en technologies de l’information dont dix (10) en intelligence d’affaires ;

2)Posséder dix (10) année d'expérience cumulée en modélisation de données, en architecture ETC et en réalisation d’applications en intelligence d’affaires (tableaux de bord, rapports etc.);

3)Posséder sept (7) années d’expérience en architecture de systèmes intégrés sur une plateforme BI;

4)Posséder trois (3) années d'expérience avec les concepts de tests automatisés et leur intégration dans l'outil utilisé pour le DevOps;

5)Posséder deux (2) années d'expérience dans le déploiement de ressources automatisées via des pipelines de déploiement des ressources;

6)Avoir réalisé un (1) mandat en mode Agile d’une durée de cent jours-personnes (100 j-p.) comme conseiller en architecture d'intégration en intelligence d'affaires.

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Le lieu de travail sera déterminé selon le mandat, il peut être en télétravail ou chez le client.

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l'excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l'échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l'excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connait une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergures.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l'équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

AVANTAGES

    Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales;

    Cheminement de carrière.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Capital Deployment Manager

Project Equity

Part time: 20 hours/week

Salary: $35-$45 per hour

Remote, US based

ABOUT US

Project Equity works to expand employee ownership to preserve business legacies, retain jobs and help working people and people of color build long-term wealth. We envision a future where employee ownership is the preferred business model to strengthen small businesses and local economies and build wealth for working people and communities of color across the United States.

Project Equity’s Employee Ownership Catalyst Fund provides flexible, low-cost capital to support the transition of businesses to employee ownership.The fund is distinctive in not requiring personal guarantees from individual borrowers, its flexibility in supporting both partial and full employee ownership transitions, its ability to finance all employee ownership entity structures (employee ownership trusts, coops, and employee stock ownership plans), and its capability to make both debt and equity investments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the part-time Capital Deployment Manager at Project Equity you will be a key member of the Capital team, supporting the deployment of catalytic capital to grow employee ownership, working directly on deals and supporting the internal operations of the Employee Ownership Catalyst Fund. You will work closely with the Employee Ownership Catalyst Fund Manager, Project Equity’s Client Services team, a third party fund administration partner, and others to help provide financing to a growing number of companies on the employee ownership pathway.

The role offers an opportunity to work directly with business owners, employee ownership practitioners, investors, and ecosystem partners while helping to build a national market for employee ownership finance.

ABOUT YOU

The ideal candidate combines strong organizational, financial analysis, and lending skills with a passion for economic justice, employee ownership, and impact investing. If the following statements describe you, we encourage you to apply:

  • You love finance.You have strong financial analysis skills and experience building and reviewing financial models that assess historical performance, develop forward-looking projections, and evaluate cash flow across a variety of businesses.

  • You are highly organized.You excel at managing multiple priorities and have a strong orientation toward developing, improving, and maintaining effective organizational processes and systems.

  • You are an outstanding communicator.You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and are comfortable working with people from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

  • You are mission-driven.You are committed to Project Equity’s mission of expanding employee ownership to preserve business legacies, retain jobs, and help working people and communities of color build long-term wealth.

  • You are excited to grow your employee ownership expertise.Familiarity with or experience working with employee ownership structures—including ESOPs, worker cooperatives, and Employee Ownership Trusts (EOTs)—is a plus.

  • You embrace technology.You are eager to learn and apply new technologies to improve efficiency, analysis, and decision-making, including the thoughtful use of AI-powered applications.

HOW YOU WILL SUPPORT THE WORK OF PROJECT EQUITY

Borrower Identification and Management

  • Track internally and externally generated capital deployment opportunities

  • Support externally generated financing opportunities, including meeting with representatives of opportunities, processing of NDA’s, obtaining appropriate financial and other materials and conducting preliminary due diligence

Opportunity underwriting and analysis

  • Provide project management support as opportunities move through the capital placement processes, including application, underwriting, securing loan/investment committee approval, state guarantee (as appropriate), and deal closing

  • Act as a key point of contact between borrowers, the EO technical assistance team, other lenders, underwriters, legal support, and others to ensure that process and approval timelines are met

Fund operations support

  • Maintain internal and external fund operations meeting schedules and other communications, including materials preparation and tracking

  • Lead quarterly/annual investor financial and impact reporting

  • Prepare internal deal specific and portfolio summary documents to support internal decision making

  • Manage online document storage for the Employee Ownership Catalyst Fund and for individual fund transactions

  • Contribute to a supportive and high-functioning workplace by communicating proactively, embracing diverse perspectives, celebrating wins, navigating challenges together, and championing a culture of continuous feedback and mutual respect

TO APPLY

To be considered for this position, please fill out ouronline applicationand upload your resume and cover letter. In your cover letter, please explain what motivates you to work with Project Equity, and how your experience, skills and commitment will advance our work to create a more equitable economy.


Requirements

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent education/experience, MBA preferred

  • 5 years of work experience, including 2+ years experience in one or more functions that support the execution of loans at a loan fund, CDFI, or bank.

  • Knowledge of commercial lending processes and standard lending terms.

  • Experience or familiarity with impact investing and how evaluating loans and investments may differ when social or environmental goals are considered alongside financial returns.

  • Strong project management abilities


Benefits

BENEFITS

  • Retirement (401K or Roth): Match 100% up to the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%.

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Well-being Resources and Caregiver Support

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Training and Development

  • Up to $500.00 annually for education reimbursement

  • Holiday pay for regular part-time employees

  • Vacation days: up to 60 hours (subject to work schedule)

  • Sick days: up to 40 hours (subject to work schedule)

raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the Team & Role
The AI Platform team is responsible for building the foundational infrastructure that powers intelligent experiences across Mozilla products. This includes model training pipelines, high-throughput inference services, GPU orchestration, and secure, privacy-respecting AI systems that operate reliably at global scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong platform mindset to help design, build, and operate Mozilla’s AI platform. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and production infrastructure—ensuring that models can be trained, deployed, and served efficiently, securely, and at scale. You will collaborate closely with product, infrastructure, and security teams to enable fast iteration while meeting strict performance and privacy requirements.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and operate core platform services and APIs used to deploy and serve production workloads at scale.
  • Own service reliability end-to-end, driving improvements in availability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence.
  • Lead efforts to optimize backend services for throughput, latency, and cost efficiency across distributed infrastructure.
  • Design and manage Kubernetes-based workloads, including GitOps deployment pipelines, environment configuration, and resource utilization optimization.
  • Own and improve critical parts of the service lifecycle, including packaging, versioning, testing strategies, validation, and deployment automation.
  • Implement and evolve observability practices (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) to improve visibility and operational resilience of backend services and pipelines.
  • Partner closely with product, infrastructure, security, and data teams to design scalable platform capabilities that enable new product features.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions, propose architectural improvements, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in and help improve operational processes, including incident response, on-call rotations, and post-incident reviews.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree with 4–6 years of relevant industry experience, or Master's degree with significant hands-on experience building and operating production systems, or work experience equivalent
  • Strong, modern Python skills, with experience writing clean, maintainable code and working with a fast toolchain (dependency management, linting, formatting, type checks, pre-commit), building both libraries and CLIs that output structured data.
  • Advance experience with database deployment and management, bonus points for familiarity with Postgres
  • Proven experience deploying and operating workloads in cloud environments, including production-grade infrastructure on GCP and GKE (artifact registries, managed caches, networking and internal load balancing, VPC, DNS, and separation of nonprod and prod).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm, writing charts that deploy across environments with per-environment configuration and progressive feature rollout.
  • Experience with Terraform for provisioning infrastructure across environments, including schema validation and PR-level plan review.
  • Experience designing and running scalable APIs that hold up under load, including health and readiness checks, auth, and clean startup and shutdown.
  • Experience with Grafana or similar tools for metrics, dashboards, and reading application and infrastructure health together during rollouts.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug performance and reliability issues in distributed systems.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams.
  • On-call experience, including participating in incident response and post-incident reviews.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with Ray or Ray Serve for GPU-backed model serving, including setting resource requests and replica counts aligned with available hardware.
  • Experience building stateless ML services such as embedding or similarity models, including multi-model loading, runtime device selection, batch APIs, and handling model-cache and cold-start tradeoffs.
  • Experience running a multi-provider LLM gateway, including routing between providers, migrating models, and mixing self-hosted with third-party serving.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration systems in production environments beyond core Kubernetes/Helm usage.
  • Exposure to privacy-preserving ML techniques, security best practices, or responsible AI system design.
  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects or leadership in building reusable internal tooling.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Overview:

This role involves editing and producing high-impact video content, designing motion graphics, and delivering platform-optimized short-form content (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) that aligns with our brand and project objectives.

The ideal candidate has proven experience in podcast content production (full episode edits, highlights, teasers, and trailers), strong capability in short-form storytelling, and hands-on expertise creating AI-assisted video content (AI voice, AI avatars, generative visuals, automated captions, and smart enhancement workflows) while maintaining a high-quality, human-centered creative output.

In addition, the candidate should be confident working with professional camera systems and production setups—understanding camera types, lenses, framing, lighting basics, audio capture best practices, and file formats—to ensure smooth post-production workflows and consistent visual quality.

This position requires excellent storytelling sense, strong technical editing skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines and maintaining brand consistency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Edit raw footage into polished final deliverables (transitions, pacing, color correction/grading, and sound design/mixing).

  • Produce promotional videos, ads, tutorials, explainers, and brand stories.

  • Create platform-optimized exports (YouTube/Instagram/TikTok/LinkedIn) with correct aspect ratios and safe zones.

  • Organize files, proxies, templates, and assets for an efficient workflow.

Podcast Editing & Repurposing

  • Edit full podcast episodes (video + audio): noise reduction, EQ, compression, leveling, and multi-camera sync.

  • Produce highlights, teasers, intros/outro, trailers, and episodic branding elements.

  • Add captions/subtitles, chapter markers, and engaging overlays to improve retention and accessibility.

  • Ensure audio loudness consistency suitable for publishing platforms.

Reels / Shorts / TikTok Production

  • Produce high-retention short-form videos with strong hooks, fast pacing, dynamic captions, and clear CTAs.

  • Repurpose long-form content into multiple short clips using value-first storytelling.

  • Create A/B variants (hooks, captions, thumbnails, pacing) to improve watch time and engagement.

Motion Graphics Design

  • Create motion graphics, animations, and VFX to enhance storytelling.

  • Design title sequences, lower thirds, transitions, and on-screen graphics.

  • Build reusable motion templates aligned with brand guidelines.

AI Video Production (AI Films & Creative Content)

  • Produce AI-assisted videos and short films using generative visuals, AI voice/avatars, upscaling, and automated workflows.

  • Blend traditional editing with AI pipelines (script-to-video, smart cut downs, auto captions).

  • Ensure ethical and legally safe usage of AI-generated assets (rights/licensing/brand compliance).

Professional Cameras & Production Expertise

  • Work with professional camera systems (bodies, lenses, frame rates, codecs, profiles) to ensure production-ready footage.

  • Apply lighting and composition fundamentals to improve quality and post-production efficiency.

  • Manage audio capture best practices (lav/shotgun/recorders) and media offload/backups.

Concept Development

  • Brainstorm concepts and storyboard/script with marketing and creative teams.

  • Ensure content aligns with brand voice, style, and objectives.

Software & Tools Proficiency

  • Use Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, and Cinema 4D (plus audio tools as needed).

  • Stay updated with trends, techniques, and new tools in editing, motion design, and AI video.

Quality Assurance

  • Review, revise, and troubleshoot technical issues (sync, codecs, renders, color consistency).

  • Ensure final exports meet platform specs and internal standards.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Align with stakeholders on goals, deadlines, and deliverables.

  • Present drafts and final cuts for feedback and approval.

​

Requirements

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Production, Graphic Design, Animation, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Proven experience in video editing and motion graphics design with a strong portfolio showcasing diverse projects.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator).
  • Knowledge of 3D animation software (Cinema 4D, Blender) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of video storytelling, pacing, and visual aesthetics.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a creative mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to take constructive feedback.

Preferred Skills:

  • Expert in AI creative tools for video production (AI video generation, AI voice, AI avatars, generative visuals, upscaling, auto-captions, and AI-assisted editing workflows).

  • Strong experience in podcast content production (full episode editing, highlights, trailers, teasers, and repurposing long-form into short-form clips).

  • Highly creative with a strong sense of storytelling and content ideation; able to propose fresh concepts and formats proactively.

  • Experience with social media platforms and creating video content optimized for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn (formats, pacing, hooks, captions, and platform specs).

  • Solid knowledge of sound design and audio editing (noise reduction, EQ, compression, leveling, and mixing for clear, broadcast-quality sound).

  • Familiarity with photography and videography is a plus (camera basics, composition, lighting, lenses, and file formats).

We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability.
