raw.excerpt: Réinventez le média finance leader sur YouTube en France.
raw.description:
Réinventez le média finance leader sur YouTube en France. Et devenez-en le visage.

💡 L'opportunité

Vous vivez et respirez l'économie, la finance et la géopolitique ? Vous êtes capable de décrypter une crise bancaire, d'expliquer les tensions commerciales US-Chine ou d'analyser l'impact d'une décision de la BCE. Et de le faire de manière captivante face caméra ?

Nous vous offrons bien plus qu'un poste : une mission de transformation.

Notre média finance francophone, leader sur YouTube avec 580 000 abonnés et plus de 700 vidéos, 140 000 followers sur X et une newsletter qui touche 50 000 lecteurs chaque semaine, a été construit sur un format faceless. Aujourd'hui, à l'heure où l'IA permet à n'importe qui de produire du contenu, nous voulons réinventer le modèle. Notre conviction : l'avenir du média digital, c'est la confiance, l'authenticité et l'interaction humaine. Et ça passe par un visage, une voix, une personnalité. La vôtre.

Nous sommes GreenTomatoMedia (https://greentomatomedia.com/), une boîte atypique basée en Thaïlande. Nous ne faisons pas de l'agence pour des clients, nous créons nos propres médias. Notre équipe gère déjà plusieurs chaînes YouTube à succès (600K+ abonnés cumulés) dans la finance et l'économie, avec un écosystème complet : forte présence sur X (Twitter), canal Telegram actif, newsletter établie, et des comptes Instagram et Facebook à développer avec une nouvelle stratégie à construire.

Notre ADN ? Informer et éduquer sans aucune langue de bois. Pas de discours lissé, pas de narratif mainstream réchauffé. On est là pour mettre le doigt là où ça fait mal : les réalités économiques que personne n'ose expliquer clairement, les angles morts de la politique monétaire, les vérités sur l'immobilier, l'épargne ou la dette que les médias traditionnels survolent ou édulcorent. Un esprit contrarian, indépendant, qui préfère les faits inconfortables aux belles histoires rassurantes.

Un projet d'internationalisation est en cours pour lancer une version anglophone. Vous participerez également à cette expansion.

Important : Nous recherchons exclusivement des francophones natifs, notre contenu nécessitant une maîtrise parfaite des nuances linguistiques et culturelles.

🎯 Votre mission

Grande autonomie avec accompagnement d'un expert. C'est VOTRE projet, vous menez la danse, mais vous n'êtes pas seul.

🔄 Réinventer le média

  • Repenser le modèle faceless pour créer un média incarné, authentique, qui génère de la confiance à l'heure où le contenu IA est partout
  • Proposer et mettre en œuvre une nouvelle vision : formats, ton, positionnement, interaction avec l'audience
  • Identifier ce qui doit changer, ce qui doit rester, et avoir le courage de faire pivoter ce qui ne fonctionne plus

🎬 Devenir le visage du média

  • Présenter les vidéos face caméra avec charisme, clarté et crédibilité
  • Incarner l'expertise du média : votre audience doit vous faire confiance quand vous parlez d'investissement, de marchés ou de géopolitique
  • Développer votre personal brand en symbiose avec celle du média
  • Interagir avec la communauté : répondre, créer du lien, fidéliser

🧠 Définir la stratégie (avec l'appui d'un stratégiste YouTube expert)

  • Faire évoluer la ligne éditoriale en restant toujours pertinent sur l'actualité économique et financière
  • Chasser les sujets à fort potentiel grâce à votre veille quotidienne
  • Tester, itérer, trouver les formats qui marchent
  • Analyser les performances et pivoter en temps réel

📱 Développer l'écosystème multiplateforme

  • X (Twitter) : renforcer la forte présence existante, réactivité, threads d'analyse, engagement
  • Newsletter : faire évoluer le contenu, exclusivités, fidélisation, monétisation
  • Instagram & Facebook : concevoir et déployer une nouvelle stratégie (Reels, carrousels, stories…)
  • Adapter le contenu à chaque plateforme

✍️ Piloter le contenu et la production

  • Écrire et superviser les scripts qui transforment l'actu éco/finance en contenus captivants, avec un ton direct et une bonne dose de storytelling
  • Manager une rédactrice et coordonner la production avec l'équipe de montage
  • Collaborer avec le responsable partenariats pour intégrer les collaborations
  • Garantir l'excellence éditoriale : sourcing béton, fact-checking rigoureux, zéro approximation
  • Tirer parti de l'IA pour accélérer vos workflows

🎙️ Perspectives futures

Le poste ne s'arrête pas là. À mesure que le média évolue, de nouveaux chantiers s'ouvriront :

  • Lancer et animer un podcast : interviews d'experts, analyses de fond, débats sur l'actualité économique
  • Organiser des lives et des sessions de Q&A avec la communauté
  • Inviter et interviewer des personnalités du monde de la finance, de l'économie et de la géopolitique
  • Expérimenter de nouveaux formats : débriefs d'actu en direct, tables rondes, formats courts, séries thématiques

Vous aurez carte blanche pour proposer ce qui n'existe pas encore.

🎯 Vous êtes la bonne personne si...

Non négociable :

  • Francophone natif. Les nuances linguistiques comptent énormément.
  • Expertise démontrée en finance, économie et géopolitique. Diplôme, parcours pro, publications, ou contenu créé sur ces sujets.
  • Vous SAVEZ écrire. Portfolio à l'appui.
  • Vous crevez l'écran. Charisme face caméra, voix qui porte, capacité à captiver. Envoyez-nous une vidéo, on veut voir !

Les gros plus :

  • Expérience audiovisuelle ou YouTube
  • Approche AI-first. Vous utilisez l'IA au quotidien et avez une vision claire de son impact sur les médias.
  • Vous avez déjà lancé ou fait grandir un média. Vous savez scaler un projet ou pivoter un format.
  • Vous maîtrisez les réseaux sociaux : Instagram, X, Facebook, Telegram
  • Vous parlez anglais. Un atout pour le projet d'internationalisation.
  • Expérience en management d'équipe ou de projets éditoriaux

Le portrait type :

  • Les Échos, Bloomberg, Financial Times avant votre café
  • Vous pouvez expliquer le quantitative easing à votre grand-mère
  • Quand une crise éclate, vos amis vous appellent pour comprendre
  • On vous écoute quand vous parlez. Naturellement.
  • Vous êtes frustré par le retard des médias francophones sur ces thématiques. Et vous savez qu'on peut faire tellement mieux.
  • Quand on vous confie un projet, vous ne le gérez pas. Vous le réinventez.

🎁 Ce que nous offrons

Environnement de travail :

  • Travail 100% à distance
  • Possibilité de rejoindre nos bureaux en Thaïlande
  • Équipe internationale et dynamique

Une opportunité unique :

  • 580 000 abonnés dès le jour 1. L'audience est là.
  • Carte blanche pour transformer. Vous avez le mandat de réinventer.
  • Infrastructure de production complète : monteurs, voix off, graphistes, outils pro
  • Stratégiste YouTube expert à vos côtés (5+ ans d'expérience)
  • Projet d'internationalisation. Lancez la version anglophone.
  • Devenez une figure médiatique. Construisez votre personal brand avec le soutien d'une structure établie.

Rémunération et avantages :

  • Salaire fixe compétitif + variable de performance
  • Politique de congés payés Illimités
  • Événements d'équipe en ligne et hors ligne
  • Assurance santé après la période d'essai

📋 Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien initial (30 min à 1h). On fait connaissance, on évalue le fit mutuel.
  2. Mise en situation (1 semaine) :
    • Rédaction d'un script vidéo sur un sujet d'actualité économique et enregistrement d'une vidéo face caméra sur ce même sujet
    • Construction d'une ligne éditoriale vidéo : Sélection de 5 sujets clés avec l'angle de traitement et la justification stratégique de chacun
    • Test de raisonnement analytique
  3. Entretien final avec le manager et présentation détaillée des exercices (1h)

📩 Pour postuler

Merci de nous envoyer :

  • Votre CV
  • Un portfolio : articles, blog, scripts, vidéos, contenus créés ou tout élément démontrant votre expertise et vos capacités rédactionnelles
  • Une courte vidéo (1 à 3 min) dans laquelle vous vous présentez rapidement et expliquez vos motivations pour ce poste. Pas besoin de setup technique particulier, un smartphone suffit. On veut voir qui vous êtes, pas la qualité de votre caméra.

Rejoignez-nous pour réinventer LA référence francophone sur l'économie et la finance. Et au-delà.

Lieu : Travail à distance ou bureaux à Chiang Mai

Département : Média

Type d'emploi : Temps plein

Expérience minimum : Niveau intermédiaire à senior

raw.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

In-law relationships can be a source of tension that strains marriages and families. Miscommunication, unmet expectations, loyalty conflicts, and differing family cultures often create friction that feels difficult to resolve. We are seeking a contract writer to serve mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law who desire wisdom for navigating these complex family dynamics. This book should offer biblical insight and practical guidance that strengthens marriages and extended families rather than deepening division.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

About Monaire
Monaire is building the infrastructure layer for intelligent commercial HVAC. We combine on-device sensors, smart thermostats, and machine-learning systems to automate control, surface real operational insight, and materially reduce energy waste at scale.

This is not offline modeling or notebook ML. Models run in production, interact with physical systems, and must be observable, debuggable, and correct. The platform spans edge devices, cloud services, streaming pipelines, control logic, and ML inference.

Engineers here work on:

  • Data ingestion and streaming at scale from heterogeneous hardware

  • Low-latency decision pipelines and control loops

  • ML systems that survive missing data, drift, and adversarial real-world conditions

  • Infrastructure for model deployment, monitoring, and rollback

  • Apps and services that customers depend on to run their buildings every day

The market is large, broken, and technically underserved. We’re scaling the system and need engineers who care about correctness, performance, and ownership — people who want to build infrastructure that actually controls the physical world, not just dashboards that look good in demos.

Role Overview

As aData Scientist / Senior Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in buildingproduction-grade ML systemsthat drive real-world outcomes—energy efficiency, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and operational intelligence for HVAC/R systems.

You will work closely withbackend engineers, product managers, and domain expertsto translate raw sensor data into reliable models that power customer-facing features and internal decision-making.

This role requires someone who canthink long-term architecturally, while deliveringshort-term, measurable impactin a fast-moving startup environment.

What You'll Do:

  • Scale ML systems for 5X growth—optimize batch processing, database queries, and model inference

  • Design ML models for time-series data, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance

  • Optimize production systems: <3s response times, 30% cost reduction, 99.9% uptime

  • Database optimization (MongoDB): indexes, connection pooling, 3-5X performance improvement

  • Batch processing: parallel processing, async operations, memory management

  • Model optimization: <500ms inference latency, caching strategies

  • NLP & LLM: enhance conversational AI bots with intelligent query generation

  • Build monitoring systems: real-time dashboards, SLA tracking, automated scaling

Must-Have Skills

  • 2+ years hands-on data science/ML experience

  • Database optimization: Index design, query tuning

  • IoT/sensor data experience, startup experience

  • AWS: Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, ElastiCache/Redis

raw.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.

Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

Collaboration Products

The Collaboration Products team owns the enterprise systems that Airbnb's workforce relies on to plan, build, and deliver — including our Atlassian ecosystem, AI-powered tooling integrations, and custom-built engineering platforms. Our mission goes beyond keeping the lights on. We are moving fast to modernize our stack, retire technical debt, and integrate AI capabilities that directly multiply the productivity and quality of the teams we serve. We build with urgency, operate with rigor, and treat every system we touch as an opportunity to raise the bar on what BizTech delivers to Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Senior Systems Engineer is a hands-on technical leader who moves fast, builds to last, and uses AI as a force multiplier — not a future initiative. In this role, you will own the configuration, migration, and continuous improvement of Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, including leading the active deprecation of Jira Data Center and full transition to Jira Cloud. But your impact goes beyond administration. You will identify where AI and automation can compress delivery cycles, reduce toil, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems our workforce depends on — and then build those improvements, quickly. You bring the platform depth to architect scalable solutions and the judgment to know when to move fast and when to be deliberate. You are the kind of engineer who raises the velocity and quality of everyone around you.

A Typical Day:

  • Serve as the primary SME and hands-on administrator for JiraCloud Software, JiraCloud Service Management (JSM), and associated Atlassian tooling; own configuration standards, governance, and technical debt reduction across the environment
  • Architect and implement scalable Jira configurations including custom workflows, issue type hierarchies, permission schemes, notification schemes, screens, and field configurations aligned with Atlassian best practices
  • Lead and execute Jira migrations - including Data Center to Cloud - coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver seamless cutover experiences
  • Design and configure Jira Service Management projects including SLAs, custom queues, JSM Forms, approval workflows, and security schemes to support internal service delivery teams
  • Build and maintain advanced analytics, dashboards, and reporting solutions using native tooling for Jira Cloud as a first line of options; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy & legal prerogatives. Airbnb is building custom Forge applications that will require your ongoing maintenance and partnership with supporting systems engineering teams.
  • Configure and administer Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, license tier optimization, and security posture improvements
  • Evaluate if Atlassian Marketplace plugins architecture evolves to a point where Airbnb could consider adopting plugins where business needs dictate, and where security, legal, and privacy requirements are satisfied.
  • Act as a strategic partner to business stakeholders by leading requirements-gathering sessions, translating business needs into technical designs, and proactively identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement
  • Configure and expand Atlassian Rovo AI agents and automation rules; evaluate emerging AI/ML capabilities within the Atlassian ecosystem and champion responsible, contextually appropriate AI adoption aligned with Airbnb's mission
  • Write and maintain custom automation rules using Jira's native Automation engine and JavaScript; leverage Jira REST API for integrations, data imports, and custom reporting
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) efforts for platform changes and migrations; develop and maintain test plans, test scripts, and defect tracking documentation
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) as needed; operate as Scrum Master or Product Owner for platform-focused workstreams
  • Document system configurations, runbooks, and knowledge base articles to support operational continuity and enable self-service across the organization
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide escalation support for critical Atlassian platform issues

Your Expertise:

  • 7+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (across JiraCloud & JiraDC) in enterprise environments with large user populations
  • Deep expertise in Jira workflow design, including post functions, validators, conditions, and custom properties; strong command of JQL for filters, subscriptions, dashboards, and board configuration
  • Proven experience leading Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud), including project configuration migration, macro compatibility, and data integrity validation
  • Experience configuring and administering Jira Cloud native tooling for capacity planning and portfolio reporting
  • Proficiency with Atlassian Marketplace plugins including JavaScripting
  • Hands-on experience with Jira REST API using tools like Postman (GET/PUT/POST) for data extraction, integration, and custom reporting workflows
  • Experience integrating Atlassian tools with identity providers via LDAP familiarity with user lifecycle management, license governance, and security hardening practices
  • Working knowledge of Atlassian Rovo and AI/ML capabilities within the Atlassian ecosystem; ability to configure Rovo agents with careful consideration for AI ethics, value alignment, and contextual appropriateness
  • Experience configuring Jira Automation rules (native and scripting-based); working knowledge of JavaScripting and JSON for custom automation
  • Strong background in Jira Service Management including SLA configuration, JSM Forms, custom queues, and approval workflows
  • Experience leading UAT for complex migrations and platform changes; proficiency in developing and executing test plans, test scripts, and defect documentation
  • Familiarity with SAFe Agile (SAFe Agilist and/or SAFe Scrum Master certification a plus); experience as Scrum Master or Product Owner for technical workstreams
  • Strong analytical and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in a remote-first, high-growth environment; ability to independently manage multiple priorities and keep stakeholders informed
  • Familiarity with complementary enterprise tools such as Slack, Asana, Figma, Airtable, and Miro is an advantage

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$164,000—$193,000 USD

raw.description:
En tant que Cybersecurity Consultant, vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans la protection des systèmes d'information de nos clients:

Pentesting (Test d'intrusion):

Concevoir et réaliser des tests d'intrusion avancés sur les infrastructures informatiques, les applications web, les réseaux et les systèmes.

Analyser les vulnérabilités découvertes et proposer des solutions appropriées pour les corriger.

Rédiger des rapports détaillés sur les résultats des tests d'intrusion et présenter les conclusions aux parties prenantes.

SMSI (Système de Management de la Sécurité de l'Information):

Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et maintenir un SMSI conforme aux normes internationales telles que ISO 27001.

Effectuer des évaluations des risques et mettre en place des contrôles de sécurité adaptés.

Assurer la formation des employés sur les politiques de sécurité de l'information et s'assurer de leur conformité.

PSSI (Politique de Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information):

Développer et mettre en œuvre des politiques de sécurité des systèmes d'information conformes aux réglementations en vigueur.

Évaluer régulièrement l'efficacité des politiques de sécurité et apporter des ajustements en fonction de l'évolution des menaces.

Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour assurer la cohérence des politiques de sécurité à travers l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Veille Technologique:

Suivre les tendances et les évolutions dans le domaine de la cybersécurité.

Mettre à jour continuellement les connaissances techniques et rester informé des nouvelles méthodes d'attaque.

Coordination de Projets:

Coordonner et superviser la mise en œuvre des mesures de sécurité, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes.

Assurer le suivi des projets de cybersécurité et garantir leur conformité aux objectifs fixés.

  • Détenir un diplôme d'une grande école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou d'université en informatique, en génie ou en cybersécurité, ou posséder une expérience de travail pertinente dans la sécurité informatique.
  • L'obtention de certifications telles que CISSP, ISO27001, CompTIA Security+ ou SANS est un plus.

Si vous êtes un penseur stratégique, possédez une solide expérience technique en cybersécurité et avez la capacité d'influencer les réponses organisationnelles aux défis de sécurité en constante évolution, nous vous encourageons à postuler pour cette opportunité passionnante. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de la posture de cybersécurité de notre organisation.

Devoteam Tunisie est un cabinet à taille humaine de plus de 120 collaborateurs, la pluridisciplinarité est notre point fort. Une équipe d’excellence et une expertise de 13 années au service de nos clients, avec un ADN “Digital Native” qui font de nous une référence sur le marché du consulting IT aussi bien à l’échelle nationale qu’internationale.

Nous recherchons un Senior Cybersecurity Consultant avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience pratique dans le domaine de l'IT et/ou de la sécurité, avec une compréhension approfondie de divers concepts et technologies de sécurité.

raw.excerpt: About Williamsburg Learning At Williamsburg Learning (WL), we aim to prepare promising students for meaningful lives as principled leaders.
raw.description:
About Williamsburg Learning

At Williamsburg Learning (WL), we aim to prepare promising students for meaningful lives as principled leaders. We partner with schools like Williamsburg Academy, Leadership Academy of Utah, and Williamsburg Academy of Colorado to deliver transformational learning experiences that spark curiosity, growth, and purpose.

We live by our values—Growth, Right Action, and a Culture of Belonging. We believe work should be meaningful and fun. Our team is authentic, connected, and committed to doing the right thing for each other and the students we serve.

To support our people, WL offers 100% paid health premiums for full-time employees (75% for families), a 100% 401(k) match up to 4%, PTO, plus many more perks!

If our mission and culture resonate with you, we would love to have you on our team!

Position Summary

The Program Assistant supports the instructional and operational needs of a designated academic program at Williamsburg Learning. Reporting to the Program Leader, this role supports mentors by grading assignments, assisting during live classes, maintaining and updating courses, substituting when mentors are absent, and addressing program needs as they arise. Program Assistants play a key role in strengthening overall program quality and supporting mentors so they can focus on high-impact teaching.

Essential Duties (Top 5 Roles)

Program Assistants are expected to be prepared to fulfill all responsibilities outlined below. However, the Program Leader determines how support hours are allocated based on the program's evolving needs, and the mix of duties may vary week to week.

1) Collaboration & Professional Practice

  • Attend the program’s weekly L10 meeting to stay aligned on priorities and mentor needs.
  • Capture clear notes during L10 meetings, track assigned action items, and create Asana tasks to support follow-through.
  • Meet regularly with the Program Leader to review workload, clarify expectations, and plan upcoming support.
  • Track assigned hours and communicate how time is being allocated.
  • Communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally with students and colleagues across email, phone, and virtual meetings.
  • Contribute positively to the Williamsburg Learning community by modeling the organization’s core values of Culture of Belonging, Right Action, and Growth.

2) Instructional Support

  • Attend live classes to support student engagement, breakout rooms, and collaborative activities.
  • Assist during presentations, simulations, and project-based learning experiences.
  • Hold office hours to provide additional academic help and encouragement.
  • Build positive, professional relationships with students.
  • Substitute for mentors using prepared materials to ensure continuity of instruction.

3) Grading & Feedback Support

  • Grade assignments using established rubrics and guidelines.
  • Complete grading for self-paced courses that have a live, synchronous equivalent.
  • Provide clear, supportive written feedback to students.
  • Alert mentors to patterns of concern or student struggles.
  • Support grading coverage during mentor absences.

4) Course & Program Operations

  • Maintain and update Canvas course pages.
  • Prepare courses for upcoming semesters.
  • Update rubrics, pacing guides, and calendars as directed.
  • Proofread and refine course materials.
  • Recommend improvements to course and program materials.

5) Student Support & Accommodations

  • Organize and maintain accommodation information for mentors.
  • Implement approved accommodations within Canvas.
  • Monitor and communicate when additional support may be needed.
  • Assist in preparing modified materials or guided notes.
  • Help ensure systems are in place for consistent student support.

Non-Essential Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of the activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma required.
  • Demonstrated experience or academic background in the subject area of the assigned program.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage delegated priorities and adjust workload based on program needs.
  • Experience using learning management systems (Canvas preferred).
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with instructional staff.
  • Interest in developing as an educator; experience working with students preferred.

Physical and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to attend meetings or classes during the standard school day.
  • Ability to manage multiple digital systems simultaneously (video conferencing, chat, attendance, instructional materials).
  • Work is performed remotely and requires a quiet, professional workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and devices suitable for live instruction.

Benefits

After meeting the eligibility requirements, benefits are available, including Health, 401(k) Retirement, Paid Holidays, and Paid Time Off.

Salary Range

  • $17.50 per hour
  • 15-20 Hours Per Week

Williamsburg Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer
